This is a stark reality in 149 countries out of 195, where Stripe operates in only 46, leaving creators to navigate the uncharted waters of payment processing. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, exacerbating the problem for those relying on this platform.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, giving creators full ownership and control over their digital products. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution deployed in 48 hours, featuring Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. In contrast, Lemon Squeezy is a payment platform that charges higher transaction fees and lacks the infrastructure sovereignty that COREMERCH provides.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH has designed its infrastructure to handle restricted countries effectively, providing a solution that is not a workaround but a base-layer infrastructure. This means that creators can sell products without relying on Stripe or other platforms that restrict access. In contrast, Lemon Squeezy is limited by the same country restrictions that affect Stripe, leaving creators without a reliable payment processing solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Lemon Squeezy's higher fees are a significant real cost for creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

To choose the right architecture, consider the level of infrastructure sovereignty you need, the number of products you want to sell, and the fees you are willing to pay. If you want a comprehensive solution that provides full ownership and control, COREMERCH is the better choice. If you prefer a payment platform with higher fees, Lemon Squeezy may be the better option.
Who is the competitor of Lemon Squeezy?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides full ownership and control over digital products.

If you're looking for a free lemon squeezy alternative for restricted countries, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) — a base-layer infrastructure solution deployed in 48 hours, featuring GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. You can also explore Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a more comprehensive solution with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. For more information, visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these concrete steps: Choose the right architecture based on your needs, select the payment processor and infrastructure components, configure the solution, test the payment processing and delivery, and hand off the solution to the creator. Ensure proper configuration of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for secure email delivery. Deploy the solution on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for a scalable and secure hosting environment.
